title: The Last Cart Down
blurb: Gate A has three locks, one for each floor. A slope from two points, a rule from a log that starts at post two, and an inequality where the sign has to turn. Somebody in a helmet covered in writing is sitting in the last cart, and he does not wait.
note: Captions stay on. It opens at the third lock, then goes back two minutes. Pause after Marcus says "Plus two!" and ask what the incident slip will say. When Doug says "Coo.", ask the class to walk the log back to post zero before Marcus does. At the third lock, pause on "Which way does the sign go?" The film ends by handing the class the Gate A check: three questions, one per floor, done alone and in silence.
